context_for_next_testing_agent: No relevant testing skill found. Use the Emergent preview origin, not localhost, because the live VPS API CORS allows the preview origin. The focused Playwright script delays /api/trade/place by 1.4s to make transient disabled states observable. Latest run: UP disabled true 34/34 samples, DOWN disabled true 0/30, rapid UP 1/5, rapid DOWN 5/5, balance 500 -> 499 immediately after UP.
rca_of_the_issue: The fix is partial. placeTrade no longer returns early on placing, and DOWN no longer has disabled={placing}, but UP still has disabled={placing}. Because DemoTrade still calls setPlacing(true) for every trade request, React sets the UP button's HTML disabled property during the API round-trip, preventing back-to-back UP clicks.
